agent_final_answer: Found the help page about how presale works on Ticketmaster. Title: "How do presales work?" Located in the Ticketmaster Help Center under Buy Tickets > Presale. URL: https://help.ticketmaster.com/hc/en-us/articles/9702132309905-How-do-presales-work . It explains that presales give fans the opportunity to purchase tickets before the general sale, and that depending on the type of presale you may need to sign up to join the presale or get a code to access the ticket sale. The page has expandable sections for Artist Presale, Presales with codes or sponsors, and Fan Clubs.
